content.rationale: S3-oplog fixes the read — the current operation id from the jj op log, feeding markers' read-run-read bracketing; M-layout places the module flat at src/oplog.rs. `jj op log` carries a template, so this fixes the machine-readable form (`--no-graph --limit 1 -T id`) and returns the head operation id, carrying failures as values with their evidence (S3-err); bracketing around an operation is the markers layer's concern.
